author_preprocessing: Computational timing/compilation experiments summarized by the source benchmarking harness; repeated timings and failures are retained. No quantum hardware shots are claimed.
known_analyses_and_limitations: Benchpress 1.0 results were used in a Nature Computational Science publication. Circuit inputs and full compiler environments are not bundled in this result archive; commit/environment metadata is retained for reconstruction. Timing variation depends on hardware and software versions.
